brief_parser.Text: Take this Chemical Data Parser. Enter The Pipe and mark a Hiisi Medicine Man, a Hiisi Charmer, and a Hiisi Runner, then return. {completequest XK0J}

progress_tags.Text: Medicine Man, Charmer, and Runner. Then we speak of Volume One.

turnin_vol1.Text: The first marks are enough. Take Afirce's World Catalogue of Books - Volume One. Now mark the Hiisi Arbiter in The Pipe, 1853 by 1108. {completequest XK0N}

brief_arbiter.Text: The Hiisi Arbiter is in The Pipe, 1853 by 1108.

turnin_vol2.Text: The Arbiter is noted. Take Volume Two. Tapiolainen waits deeper in The Pipe, 1951 by 1159. Return when it falls. {completequest XK0P}

turnin_vol3.Text: The Pipe is quieter. Take Volume Three. One Whose Mind Is Riddled stands in the Forest, 1531 by 1882. {completequest XK0R}

after.Text: One Whose Mind Is Riddled is in the Forest, 1531 by 1882.
